In general, as children grow, be sure to spend less time doing things for them, and more time teaching them how to do things for themselves.

Too many parents get into a rut of just taking care of things and always making plans and preparations on behalf of their kids, even as they grow into adulthood. Downplay failures and reassure them, never exaggerate or freak out, and then teach them how to fix the mess themselves.

That way, they will enter adulthood confident and independent, not burdened by fears or anxieties, knowing they handle themselves and anything life may throw at them.
